title: Unsafe Manual Destruction of Fields
pattern: Manually calling unsafe destructors on individual fields within a `Drop` implementation without safe wrappers.
why_bad: If a panic occurs midway through the drop execution, some fields might be left partially deallocated and then dropped again, or duplicate drops can occur, leading to double-free undefined behavior.
detection: Calling `ManuallyDrop::drop` or raw pointer destruction on struct fields within a custom `Drop::drop` method without panic-safe tracking.
counterexample: Using safe option wrappers (`Option::take`) or safe standard library destructors to deallocate.
fix: Use panic-safe Option taking to cleanly extract the value: `self.field.take()` replacing it with `None`.
source: Rust For Rustaceans, Chapter 4 (Wrapper Types / ManuallyDrop) [425-427].
